result: Implemented the bounded Desktop Workstream event client. It accepts only a generated exact Workstream authority context, replays through the generated eventsStream operation, rejects malformed/foreign/duplicate/regressed events, persists the last confirmed durable cursor before committing local state, and leaves empty tails composition-free for core-owned recomposition.

generated_transport.ownership: Generated operation registry, OpenAPI, TypeScript client, validators, and HTTP transport remain the transport/DTO owners; the Desktop client adds only exact-scope and stream-order acceptance checks.

implementation: Desktop freezes a cloned generated WorkstreamAuthorityContext and validates it through the generated WorkstreamAuthorityContext contract before loading or sending a cursor.

Each poll calls MissionCanvasClient.eventsStream with the exact frozen authority and only the last confirmed after_cursor; no CWD, tab, latest-record, project-root/continuity shortcut, or local composition resolver is used.

Returned events are validated through generated ProjectionLifecycleEvent and WorkstreamAuthorityContext validators, compared against the complete authority chain, and checked for durable numeric cursor ordering, revision regression, duplicate IDs, and duplicate cursors.

Cursor persistence occurs before in-memory cursor, revision, seen-ID, and listener state is committed, so a durable write failure retries safely from the prior cursor without remounting or inventing projection state.
Empty or ineligible Workstream history produces an empty batch without inventing events, contributions, panels, layout, or a Work Rail; core remains the owner of eligibility and recomposition.
checks: npm --prefix apps/desktop test (exit 0; shell contract, canonical Desktop context, Mission Canvas renderer/transport/projection/draft/event runtime, and hostile LIVE-001 cases: PASS)

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: Generated transport and the Desktop event client reject an event whose Workstream or subordinate Attachment authority differs from the frozen request; no cursor or listener state advances.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Invalid or absent Workstream authority fails before eventsStream and before cursor loading can select a fallback.
negative_cases.stale_cursor: Malformed persisted cursors fail before HTTP; equal, regressed, non-numeric, zero event cursors, and cursor regressions are rejected without persistence.
negative_cases.stale_revision: Projection or layout revision regressions are rejected while the last confirmed cursor and projection state remain unchanged.
negative_cases.duplicate_delivery: Seen event IDs and equal durable cursor sequences are rejected; only newly accepted ordered events can advance cursor.persist.
negative_cases.out_of_order_delivery: Events arriving after a higher confirmed sequence are rejected as event_cursor_regressed; the client never sorts or invents missing events.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: A missing generated eventsStream capability fails closed before a request; generated operation availability and server permission remain transport/core-owned.
negative_cases.empty_or_ineligible_contribution: An empty exact-Workstream event tail returns no accepted events and does not persist a cursor or create a contribution; eligibility/layout remain core-owned.
negative_cases.invalid_response: Generated validators plus Desktop stream checks reject malformed event fields, scope, revisions, cursors, and refs before applying them.
negative_cases.cursor_persistence_failure: A cursor-store failure raises event_cursor_persist_failed before local state/listeners advance; the next poll retries from the previous cursor.
negative_cases.refresh_continuity: The client emits bounded event batches to the existing invalidation path and does not own shell mounting, layout, draft, focus, or scroll state.

acceptance: Foreign, duplicate, and out-of-order events are rejected.
reconnect resumes from cursor without duplicating state.
refresh does not remount the entire shell or lose focus/drafts/scroll.
events from another Workstream cannot update the active Canvas.
